headline: Flock questions, a possible ACLU meeting, and the differences between local police and ICE/Federal Enforcement.
summary: The agenda covers community feedback, Flock questions, and the roles of local police and ICE/Federal Enforcement. It also includes the Malden Community Information Network, engagement with MPD, and updates on working groups.
